Q17082155.label: 1926 Nicaraguan parliamentary election
Q17082155.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Nicaragua in November 1926 to elect half of the seats in the Chamber of Deputies and one-third of the seats in the Senate of the National Congress.

Q1327915.label: 1981 Irish general election
Q1327915.summary: The 1981 Irish general election to the 22nd Dáil was held on Thursday, 11 June, following the dissolution of the 21st Dáil on 21 May by President Patrick Hillery on the request of Taoiseach Charles Haughey.

Q1258283.label: Alliance of Independent Social Democrats
Q1258283.summary: The Alliance of Independent Social Democrats is a Serb nationalist political party in Bosnia and Herzegovina. Founded in 1996, it is the governing party in Republika Srpska. As of 2026, the party's vice-president Željka Cvijanović is the member of the Presidency of Bosnia and Herzegovina, while party member Siniša Karan is serving as the president of Republika Srpska. SNSD member Savo Minić is also the prime minister of Republika Srpska.

Q2634027.label: 2001 Belarusian presidential election
Q2634027.summary: Presidential elections were held in Belarus on 9 September 2001. The election should have been held in 1999, but a revised constitution adopted in 1996 extended incumbent Alexander Lukashenko's term for another two years.

Q2420523.label: Romanian Democratic Convention
Q2420523.summary: The Romanian Democratic Convention was an electoral alliance of several centre-right political parties in Romania, active from 1991 until 2000. The most prominent leaders of the CDR throughout the 1990s were by far Corneliu Coposu, Ion Rațiu, and Ion Diaconescu, all three members of the Christian Democratic National Peasants' Party (PNȚCD) - successor and political heir to the National Peasants' Party (PNȚ), active in the Kingdom of Romania between 1926 and 1948).
